title: Apply for a NSW licence as a temporary overseas visitor
summary: Temporary overseas visitors can apply for a temporary NSW licence to continue driving after six months.
intro:
If you’re a temporary overseas visitor who arrived in NSW after 1 July 2023, you can drive on your existing overseas licence for up to 6 months. If you wish to continue to drive after 6 months, you'll need to apply for a temporary NSW licence.

If you’re a temporary overseas visitor who arrived in NSW before 1 July 2023, and will continue to reside in NSW after 1 March 2025, you must obtain your temporary NSW driver licence before 1 March 2025 if you wish to continue to drive.

Notes:
who_can_apply: Temporary overseas visitors who arrived in NSW after 1 July 2023 can drive on their existing overseas licence for up to 6 months.
Temporary overseas visitors who arrived in NSW before 1 July 2023 and plan to continue residing in NSW after 1 March 2025 must obtain a temporary NSW driver licence before 1 March 2025.
what_you_need: A knowledge test and driving test for the relevant class of licence (unless exempt).
If your licence is from the Republic of Korea, you need documentation from the Consulate-General of the Republic of Korea.
If your licence is from Taiwan, you need documentation from the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office.

If you cannot provide a translation, you must get an authorisation letter from the relevant embassy, consulate, or diplomatic office in Australia, or a government department in the country where your licence was issued.

how_to_steps.text: Complete the form and gather your documents and any additional items (if applicable).
Visit a service centre and submit your application or book your driver or rider licence test.

more_info.text: Your visiting driving privileges will be withdrawn if you don't meet specific conditions.

faqs.q: How long can I drive in NSW on my overseas licence?
faqs.a: If you arrived after 1 July 2023, you can drive on your existing overseas licence for up to 6 months.

faqs.q: When must I apply for a temporary NSW licence?
faqs.a: If you arrived before 1 July 2023 and plan to stay past 1 March 2025, you must obtain a temporary NSW licence before 1 March 2025.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for a temporary licence?
faqs.a: You need the 'Licence Application' PDF form, proof of identity, your original overseas licence, payment, and a knowledge and driving test (unless exempt).
